items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: Ed McPartland and Goodman in it.

ctx.x: Yes, the Pollock Band. They brought in several Chicagoans, of course.
Ed McPartland and Goodman in it. At one time, Bud. Bud Livingston. I'm not quite sure where he came from.

By that time, there were very few New Orleans men in the picture around New York. I can't, offhand, I can't remember anybody from New Orleans. There were some here in Chicago, but I can't recall in New York there being any New Orleans men.
